arStrings.szText: "Are all the stories between you and Philios true?"
I cannot say what stories you have heard, nor how time has colored them. We fought together. Bled together. Broke bread. Laughed. Against all reason and strife, we loved.
Amused she is being asked about her love life. She speaks about her old lover with softness and affection.
I first met him tending to his garden. The way the light bathed him, he looked like the sun.
Philios could be blusterous and proud, but beneath all that thunder was his truest nature. A maker. Above all, he loved to create.
